ARRIE is a hospitality intelligence infrastructure platform.
It provides operational visibility, revenue coordination, and AI-driven decision support for restaurant networks.
The system is designed for enterprise hospitality operators.
It is not a consumer SaaS tool.

Key capabilities:
- Menu Intelligence: understanding how menu changes affect demand, kitchen load, delivery speed, and margin
- Revenue Dynamics: real-time visibility into how operational decisions impact financial performance
- Command Center: unified operational interface for multi-location restaurant networks
- Signal Layer: continuous interpretation of operational signals across the network

Target audience: multi-location restaurant groups, premium hospitality operators, enterprise restaurant brands.
